# Prasanth AI Headquarters coding guidance

Before making changes, read the repository-root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) in full. That is the **single canonical source** for business mission, constraints, architecture, current PR, tests, blockers and next steps. Check the latest commits before work, preserve the independent SPLCART production boundary, and append a truthful progress/handoff entry to `AGENTS.md` after each substantive milestone. Do not invent completed actions, sales, leads or integration capabilities.
